method: Whole20 current roots and explicitly cited connected paths manually read from canonical source. Metadata packaging hashes only listed explicit source spans; no source parser/scanner or source/runtime execution.

classification_definitions.integration: Actual project API/network/process/store/runtime boundary materially supports asserted target.
classification_definitions.unit: Local predicate/transform or fake-only target; incidental setup/authentication/files do not promote.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct unit-only blocks alongside material real boundary assertions.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Mapping/source or conditional-helper qualification prevents source classification.

roots.rationale: Actual loopback NATS requests acquire a session, open/fail a cycle, retrieve withdrawn desired and publish stopped report; final c.get reads actual JetStream cycle/report records. Workload Stop/Apply is a memoryRunner fake, so no subprocess or real workload shutdown is established. All assertion blocks belong to this protocol/store scenario.

Agent retrieves over signed loopback NATS session; controller provider nil rejects and an authenticated error is returned. Real protocol denial supports the asserted empty result; durable fixture grant is not itself proof of live Vault material.

Provider callback advances actual authority-backed registration through Controller.Register after durable grant read; signed NATS request is denied by post-provider recheck and returns no files. Real protocol/store race test, with synthetic provider bytes.

Fixture changes credential expiry after provider reads; subsequent signed encrypted NATS replies are checked against the prior inventory and rejected. Actual protocol boundary materially carries the changed expiry; provider is synthetic and no live Vault read occurs.

Fixture changes broker.creds after provider reads; actual signed encrypted NATS chunk delivery rejects inconsistent inventory and returns no files. Real protocol boundary, synthetic provider bytes and one-replica authority fixture.

Positive retrieval and wire subscription assert exact files, independent credential expiry, provider read count, chunk bounds and confidential credentials across signed loopback NATS and actual durable function-grant reads. Altered recipient/query and stale-session cases also send actual NATS requests; no separate direct local-only assertion block. No real function execution or live Vault credentials are qualified.

Actual upstream NATS server admits admin/reader connections over loopback TCP with distinct permissions. Direct restricted KV.Get errors; production Reader.get uses stream-leader GetLastMsg API and checks real value revision, tombstone and missing record. Error-only direct denial does not prove a unique runtime cause without execution.
Direct loadFilesystems list construction over synthetic Agent/nativeRoots/channels. Paths are strings; no statfs, mount, volume, socket or process is reached.
Direct loadFilesystems computes role/path inventory and drops closed or removed in-memory native roots. No filesystem operation or real mount is asserted.

Direct handleAuthorized dispatch filters synthetic managed Desired values from map-backed memoryMutations into a fake LoadSink. Real fixture session I/O surrounds the target but the binding predicate and sink output are local; injected verifier/gate approve fixtures. No live OCI, actual placement journal or managed workload boundary supports the target.

Agent.Run launches production publishLoad, samples through default OS system reader and sends signed NATS load to running controller; receiving sink validates report and asserts exact authenticated origin. Actual NATS publication supports target. memoryRunner supplies workload seam; OS metric values are not asserted.
Pure duration table over nextLoadWait; no timer wait or publication.

Current Desired variants come from map-backed memoryMutations; direct handleAuthorized filters roles and delivers preserved usage to fake sink. Session churn uses real JetStream as fixture/authentication setup, but the asserted environment/managed-kind filtering and local loadOutcome have no material external target boundary.

Direct load dispatch filters roles/origin from fake mutation read state, then synthetic withdrawal and fake throttling callbacks assert filtering/negative ack; independent malformed schema checks are also local. Real session CAS and mutation publish are surrounding fixture/authentication effects, not readback of asserted target. No real telemetry sink/journal is reached.
Direct dispatch reaches nil LoadSink guard and checks its error. Real session fixture is incidental to this local callback configuration rejection.

Direct handler uses map-backed desired values and fake sink to preserve allocated role with nil usage, then filters synthetic withdrawal. Real session fixture/commit publication does not make the in-memory reservation predicate an external target boundary.

Wrong-session/wrong-epoch and expired-session cases compare against actual JetStream sessionSnapshot leader reads; expired subcase changes persisted session via real CAS. Separate invalid-signature case rejects in verifyRequest before session store read, with registration from fake mutation map; that is local crypto validation. Distinct materially real store and unit blocks make mixed.

Direct load handler validates synthetic filesystem arrays and fake sink count. Duplicate/size/role/path checks reject in hostload.Report.Validate before target sink; actual authenticated session fixture I/O is incidental to schema predicate.
Pure loadOutcome/loadErrorClass calls check accepted, discarded and supplied error values. No request or telemetry publication.
In-memory Agent map timestamps are set directly; note/currentTerraBaseLoads apply expiry and removal policy. No member-status HTTP, process, timer wait or real TerraBase boundary.

func managedContractFixture() (Registration, Desired, ed25519.PrivateKey) {
	key := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(make([]byte, ed25519.SeedSize))
	registration := Registration{
		ID:   entityid.Derive("host", "gru", "node-a"),
		Cell: "gru", Node: "node-a", Environment: "production", FailureDomain: "FAULT-DOMAIN-1",
		Roles: []string{"terrabase"}, PublicKey: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(key.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)), NATSUserPublicKey: testNATSUserKey("node-a"), Generation: 1,
		Capacity: Capacity{MemoryBytes: 8 << 30}, SystemReserveBytes: 1 << 30,
		ManagedOCI:    &ManagedOCIBinding{Region: "GRU", InstanceID: "ocid1.instance.oc1..node-a", Owner: "terrascale", FleetGeneration: 1, CreateKey: "00000000000000000000000001"},
		ManagedMember: &ManagedMemberBinding{Scope: MemberScope{ClusterID: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", TenantID: "01HW000000E008000000000001", DatabaseID: "01HW000000E008000000000001", ShardID: 1, MemberID: "01HW000000E008000000000001", Incarnation: "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"}, HostAttempt: 1},
	}
	desired := Desired{Cell: "gru", Node: "node-a", Environment: "production", Role: "terrabase", Generation: 1, AuthorityEpoch: 1, Digest: strings.Repeat("a", 64),
		ManagedMember: &ManagedMemberLaunch{OCI: *registration.ManagedOCI, Member: *registration.ManagedMember,
			Authority:    MemberAuthority{Epoch: 1, ConfigurationID: strings.Repeat("c", 64), CertificateSHA256: strings.Repeat("d", 64), TLSLeafSHA256: strings.Repeat("e", 64)},
			SourceDigest: strings.Repeat("f", 64), VolumeID: "ocid1.volume.retained", AttachmentID: "ocid1.volumeattachment.node-a",
			ProcessMemoryBytes: 4 << 30, MemoryHeadroomBytes: 1 << 30, CgroupMemoryMaxBytes: 6 << 30, SystemReserveBytes: 1 << 30}}
	return registration, desired, key
}

qualification_limits: Loopback NATS servers are single-server synthetic fixtures with one-replica JetStream, not production regions, TLS credentials, R3 quorum, failover or restart durability.
FunctionMaterial provider resolves a real durable fixture grant then returns synthetic bytes; no live OCI/Vault read or real function/workload execution is qualified.

memoryMutations reads return map entries and fixture writes publish to JetStream; filtering target read state and LoadSink callbacks remain fake. Real session/authentication fixture I/O is explicitly distinguished from asserted pure filtering/schema targets.

memoryRunner applies/stops in memory; withdrawal root establishes protocol/cycle/report effects without actual subprocess shutdown. Agent load root asserts publication/origin, not exact OS metric values.
No source/repo/ledger mutation, global count/completion promotion, deletion/retirement authorization or runtime qualification; every safety obligation retained.
